files.index_note: ix_obe_ticker_ts (ticker, ts) for deltas; ix_obe_snapshot (ticker, ts desc) where kind = 'snapshot' for the anchor
files.name: orderbook_events.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select id, ts, sid, seq, raw from orderbook_events where ticker = :t and kind = 'snapshot' and ts <= :upper and ts >= :anchor_lower order by ts desc, id desc limit 1 ;; select id, ts, sid, seq, side, price, delta from orderbook_events where ticker = :t and kind = 'delta' and ts >= :lower and ts <= :upper order by ts, id limit :cap

files.index_note: ix_trades_ticker_ts (ticker, ts) -- the _WS_PRINTS projection, not select *: trade_id, ts, yes_price, count, taker_side, is_block, source
files.name: venue_trades.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select trade_id, ts, yes_price, count, coalesce(taker_outcome_side, taker_side) as taker_side, is_block, source from venue_trades where ticker = :t and ts >= :lower and ts <= :upper order by ts, trade_id limit :cap

files.index_note: ix_obe_ts_brin (ts) -- partition-pruned; the gap row is subscription-level and carries ticker = '' (review C1)
files.name: orderbook_events_gaps.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select id, ts, sid, seq, ticker, raw from orderbook_events where kind = 'gap' and ts >= :lower and ts <= :upper order by ts, id limit :cap

files.name: venue_markets.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from venue_markets where ticker = :t limit :cap

files.name: market_gap_snapshots.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from market_gap_snapshots where venue_market_id = :vm_id and created_at >= :lower and created_at <= :upper order by created_at, id limit :cap

files.name: fair_values.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from fair_values where game_id = :game_id and market_type = :market_type and created_at >= :lower and created_at <= :upper order by created_at, id limit :cap

files.index_note: no index on orders.placed_at: bounded walk, small table
files.name: orders.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from orders where placed_at >= :lower and placed_at <= :upper order by id limit :cap

files.name: fills.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from fills where filled_at >= :lower and filled_at <= :upper order by filled_at, id limit :cap

files.name: order_events.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from order_events where order_id = any(:order_ids) order by ts, id limit :cap

files.index_note: no index on ledger.order_id: sequential scan, small table
files.name: ledger.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from ledger where order_id = any(:order_ids) order by ts, id limit :cap

files.index_note: ix_metric_samples_name_ts (name, ts desc) -- explicit name list, never a LIKE prefix (review I-a1)
files.name: metric_samples.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from metric_samples where name = any(:names) and ts >= :lower and ts <= :upper order by ts, name limit :cap

files.name: operator_events.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from operator_events where ts >= :lower and ts <= :upper order by ts, id limit :cap

files.index_note: small table, full read ordered by first_seen
files.name: config_history.jsonl.gz
files.sql: select * from config_history order by first_seen limit :cap
